claims.text: The paper considers readability and grammaticality as important properties for NLG evaluation.
Automatic evaluation metrics such as BLEU and word-overlap metrics are commonly used in NLG research.
The study introduces grammar-based metrics for NLG evaluation, which do not rely on human-generated references.
The paper discusses the need for new metrics in NLG, including reference-less quality prediction.
